summary: Hange tries to make Eren answer with reasons. The reasons in the room are tidy, and they do not bring Sasha back or open his silence.

segments.ja: エレンは、島の建物の一室に置かれています。置かれている理由は、リベリオを勝手に動かした、です。動かしたあとの損害を、ハンジが扉のこちら側で数えます。数える項目は、戦鎚を得たこと、サシャを失ったこと、世界を敵に回したことです。回した三つを、彼女は一つの会話にしようとします。しようとする相手は、ほとんど答えません。答えない机が、正論の席です。部屋の窓は、港の灯が届かない高さです。
segments.en: Eren is kept in one room of a building on the island. The reason he is kept is that he moved Liberio on his own. On this side of the door, Hange counts the damage after he moved it. The items she counts are gaining the war hammer, losing Sasha, and turning the world into an enemy. She tries to make the three she turned into one conversation. The opponent she tries with hardly answers. The desk that does not answer is the seat of the sound argument. The room's window is at a height the harbor lamps do not reach.

segments.ja: ハンジは、理由を鎖のようにつなぎます。つなぐ第一は、奇襲は兵団の決定ではなかった、です。第二は、それでも戦鎚の力は島に来た、です。第三は、来た力では世界の敵意は消えず、増えた、です。増えた敵意を、彼女は憎しみと言い直します。言い直す声は、研究者の声です。研究者の声が、友の沈黙に当たります。当たっても、エレンは鎖のどれかを否定しません。否定しないことが、すでに一つの答えに見えます。
segments.en: Hange connects reasons like a chain. The first she connects is that the surprise attack was not the corps' decision. The second is that the war hammer's power came to the island anyway. The third is that the power that came did not erase the world's hatred, and increased it. She says the increased hatred again as hatred. The voice that says it again is a researcher's voice. The researcher's voice hits a friend's silence. Even hitting, Eren does not deny any link of the chain. Not denying already looks like one answer.

segments.ja: ミカサは、部屋の端でこの鎖を聞いています。聞いている彼女は、正論の穴を感情で知っています。知っている穴は、サシャの名が項目の一つで終わっている、です。終わっている扱いを、彼女はエレンに問いません。問わない理由は、問えば船の中の冷たい顔がもう一度出る、です。出る顔を、今日は見たくありません。見たくないまま、彼女は扉の位置を確認します。確認は、逃げるためではありません。隣にいるためです。
segments.en: At the edge of the room, Mikasa is listening to this chain. She, listening, knows the hole in the sound argument by feeling. The hole she knows is that Sasha's name ends as one item. She does not ask Eren about the treatment of ending. The reason she does not ask is that if she asks, the cold face inside the ship comes out once more. She does not want to see the face that comes out today. Without wanting to see it, she checks the position of the door. The check is not in order to run. It is in order to stay beside him.

segments.en: Halfway along the chain, Hange places Zeke's name. The question she places is what he decided with his older brother. If what they decided touches the lifespan of everyone on the island, it cannot remain a secret of the corps. Eren hears the sound argument that cannot remain, and shifts his eyes to the window. Outside the window he shifts to, there are soldiers of the watch. The soldiers who are there may be the side that drank the volunteers' wine yesterday. This conversation does not yet open the may. Without opening it, only the older brother's name remains on the desk.

segments.ja: 長い沈黙のあと、エレンは一つだけ言います。言う内容は、あそこにいた、です。いた、は、リベリオの子供も、兵も、自分の選択の中に入っていた、という意味に聞こえます。聞こえる意味を、ハンジは確認しようとします。確認の質問に、彼は続きを足しません。足さないことが、正論への返事です。返事は、同意ではありません。ではありません。鎖を、自分の外側の話として聞いた、という姿勢です。言った一文のあと、机の上の水は揺れません。
segments.en: After a long silence, Eren says only one thing. The content he says is that he was there. Was there sounds like a meaning that the children and the soldiers who were there were inside his choice. Hange tries to confirm the meaning that sounds so. He does not add a continuation to the question of confirmation. Not adding is the reply to the sound argument. The reply is not agreement. It is not. It is a posture of having heard the chain as a story outside himself. After the one sentence he said, the water on the desk does not move.

segments.ja: 部屋を出る前に、ミカサは自分のマフラーを直します。直す動作は、森の家の日と同じです。同じ動作を、エレンは今日は見ません。見ないことが、四年と、船の沈黙を重ねます。重ねた距離を、彼女は正論では測りません。測らない理由は、理由が届かない場所に彼がいる、です。いる場所が、兄の計画の側なのか、彼女にはまだ二つの可能性があります。可能性の両方を、彼女は扉の外まで持って出ます。
segments.en: Before leaving the room, Mikasa straightens her own scarf. The motion of straightening is the same as the day of the house in the woods. Eren does not watch the same motion today. The not watching stacks four years and the silence of the ship. She does not measure the stacked distance with a sound argument. The reason she does not measure it is that he is in a place reasons do not reach. She still has two possibilities for whether the place he is in is the side of the older brother's plan. She carries both possibilities out as far as the outside of the door.

segments.en: The sound argument was not wrong. It was not. The surprise attack was outside the decision, the war hammer came into their hands, the world became an enemy, and the older brother's plan is unpublished. Eren did not deny the unpublished chain. After he did not deny it, the room returns to its original quiet. The quiet that returns is not an agreement. Mikasa leaves last the room that is not an agreement. The scarf that leaves is cloth that reasons cannot explain. The cloth remains outside today's sound argument.

vocab.exampleEn: Connie holds a sound argument in a different shape from Hange. The shape he holds is short. The short sentence is: Sasha shared meals, she was shot, she does not return. vocab.exampleJa: 足さないことが、正論への返事です。
vocab.exampleEn: After a long silence, Eren says only one thing. The content he says is that he was there. Was there sounds like a meaning that the children and the soldiers who were there were inside his choice. Hange tries to confirm the meaning that sounds so. He does not add a continuation to the question of confirmation. Not adding is the reply to the sound argument. The reply is not agreement. It is not. It is a posture of having heard the chain as a story outside himself. After the one sentence he said, the water on the desk does not move.

vocab.exampleJa: アルミンは、別の席で義勇兵の説明と、この沈黙の報告を並べます。
vocab.exampleEn: At another seat, Armin lines up the volunteers' explanation and the report of this silence. The notebook he lines up is a continuation of yesterday's verbs on the left and right. The continuation is worse today. The reason it is worse is that Eren does not deny the chain of reasons, and he also does not repair anything. He still thinks he can persuade the friend who does not. The deadline he thinks of is before the contact with Zeke deepens. Before that, Hange leaves the room. The face that leaves is a face the sound argument did not reach.

vocab.exampleJa: 面談の報告は、兵団の中で二つに翻訳されます。
vocab.exampleEn: The report of the interview is translated in two ways inside the corps. One translation is that Eren cannot be controlled. The other is that only Eren is right. Floch carries the voice of the right side from the harbor to the building. The rightness he carries makes Sasha's death a necessary price. Jean refuses the price it makes. The refusal is less a sound argument than the memory of a plate. The memory divides people ahead of the words of the meeting.

vocab.exampleJa: イェレナは、建物の外でこの面談を失敗だとは扱いません。
vocab.exampleEn: Outside the building, Yelena does not treat this interview as a failure. The reason she does not treat it is that Eren showed the island's will with his body. She places the assault he showed above the sound argument. The rank she places collides with Hange's chain. She lets the collision pass with a smile. Onyankopon does not go along with the person she lets it pass. The maintenance hand that does not go along stops a little. The hand that stops shows there is a crack inside the volunteers too.

vocab.exampleJa: しないまま、瓶の行方を目で追います。
vocab.exampleEn: On the same day, the volunteers' wine goes around once more among the soldiers of the watch. Levi still keeps the bottle that goes around away from his own squad. The sense of keeping it away is not a sound argument. It is not. It is the memory of something that tastes good. He lines that memory up with Zeke's smile. He does not make the suspicion he lines up into an order today. Without making it, he follows the whereabouts of the bottle with his eyes. The eyes that follow are already seeing an incident of a later week. He does not make the seeing into a loud voice.

vocab.exampleEn: Hange connects reasons like a chain. The first she connects is that the surprise attack was not the corps' decision.
